en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> judged regarding a slave girl whose husband had divorced her with two divorces, then had copulated with her, so he<sup>asws</sup> had him whipped’.
